evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big box mass, medium corner posts/rails and 4 recessed planks per face, small chamfered steel corner caps.

evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on posts, rails, planks and caps catch a light highlight in the corner and planks close-ups; no razor edges.
evidence.V5: Studio and flat close-ups clean: no pinches, seams, z-fighting or stray faceting; A17/A18 pass, 0 flipped faces (cross-shell overlaps are intentional seating).
evidence.V6: One wood hue in 3 values (frame mid, planks dark, lid boards alternating light/dark) plus steel-grey caps; colourways swap the hue cleanly.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, steel-grey cap accents, ~0.045 chamfers and smooth shading match the kit crate style.
